designNotes.scope: Compact Hex Vector at the global 200-pixel device height. General modulation belongs to the Hex host.
designNotes.oscillators: Four compact numbered oscillators with ratio, frequency offset, level/modulation depth and independent keytrack sliders. Keytrack examples are 100%, 100%, 50% and 0%.
designNotes.keytrack: Each oscillator keytrack slider is vertical, immediately beside the right edge of its numbered on/off button.
